### The God of Me
Author: Melissa Spoelstra
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/girlfriends-in-god-may-25-2021.html
Passage: Genesis 33:20
Points:
- There is an important difference between talking about God and spending personal time with Him.
- By naming the altar El-Elohe-Israel, Jacob personally declared God to be his own God.
- Daily routines and to-do lists can easily create a sense of emotional and spiritual distance from the Lord.
- God cares about the ordinary details of life and desires an intimate, personal walk with every believer.

### Jacob Settles in Shechem
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/jacob-settles-shechem
Passage: Genesis 33:18-20
Points:
- Jacob stopped short of his vowed destination at Bethel to settle conveniently in Shechem.
- Choosing comfort over full obedience eventually led to grievous trouble for Jacob's household.
- Jacob still demonstrated real devotion to the true God by erecting an altar upon entering Canaan.
- Believers are challenged to keep worship at the center of their home through regular prayer and study.
